spans.s:
m. (-गः)
1 A bird.
2 A cloud.
3 An arrow.
4 The sun.
5 The moon.
6 A planet.
E.
विह for विहायस् in the sky, and ग who goes; also विहङ्गम, &c.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Going swiftly, flying.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A bird.
2 A cloud.
3 An arrow.
4 The moon.
5 The sun.
E.
विह for विहायस् in the air, and ग who goes: see the next.

m. (-मः)
A bird.
f. (-मा)
A pole or yoke for carrying burthens.
E.
विह for विहायम् in the air, गम to go, aff. खच्, whence the nasal is inserted; also with the final rejected, विहङ्ग, &c.

m. (-जः)
Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
विहङ्ग a bird, and राज king.

f. (-का)
A sort of pole or yoke for carrying burthens.
E.
विहङ्ग a bird, and कन् aff., fem. form.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Opposed, impeded, resisted.
2 Hurt, killed.
m. (-तः)
A Bauddha or Jaina temple.
E.
वि before हन to hurt or kill, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Striking, killing.
m. (-तिः)
A friend or companion.
E.
वि, हन to strike, क्तिन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Opposition, obstruction, impediment.
2 Injury, hurting.
3

Killing.
4

A bow for cleaning cotton.
E.
वि before हन to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-रः)
Separation, disunion, absence.
E.
वि before हृ to convey, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
1 Walking for pleasure or amusement.
2 Wandering, roaming, going about.
3 A Bauddha or Jaina convent.
4 Play, sport, pastime.
5 The shoulder.
6 A sort of bird.
E.
वि before हृ to take, aff. घञ्; also वीहार.

m. (-रः)
A holy place, a temple, a sanctuary, but especially a Jaina or Bauddha convent.
E.
वि before हृ to convey, aff. घञ्; also विहार.

n. (-णं)
1 Taking, taking off or away.
2 Going about for pleasure or exercise.
E.
वि, हृ to take, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be taken away.
2 To be rambled or sported.
E.
वि before हृ to take, अनीयर् aff.

n. (-नं)
Laughing gently, smiling.
E.
वि, हस to laugh, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-तं)
A gentle laugh, a smile.
E.
वि before हस to laugh, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Confounded, perplexed, bewildered.
2 Wise, learned.
E.
वि without, हस्त a hand, helpless, &c.

ind. Aptote noun.
Heaven, paradise.
E.
वि before हा to abandon, Uṇādi aff. आ.

Given.
2

Extorted.
n. (-तं)
Gift, donation.
E.
वि before हा to abandon, causal form, aff. क्त. [] giving being considered as the abandonment of the thing given.

ind.
Having left or abandoned.
E.
वि before हा to quit, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-तं)
Gift, donation.

mn. (-याः-यः)
The sky or atmosphere.
m. (-याः)
A bird.
E.
वि before हय to go, causal form, aff. असुन्.

mn. (-सः-सं)
Heaven, sky, atmosphere.
m. (-सः)
A bird.
E.
अच् added to the last.

ind.
Heaven, sky, atmosphere.
E.
the third case of विहायस् used as an aptote noun.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Taking pleasure or relaxation.
E.
विहार sport, &c., and इनि aff.

m. (-सः)
A gentle laugh or smile.
E.
वि, and हास laugh.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Placed, deposited.
2 Improper, unsuitable, unfit.
3 Done, acted, made.
4 Appointed, fixed.
E.
वि before धा to have, aff. क्त, or वि priv., and हित applicable.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Doing, performing, making.
E.
वि before धा to have, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः)
Faulty, offending, wicked.
E.
विहित done, अगस् sin.

mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि)
Making a respectful obeisance.
E.
विहित, and अञ्जलि salute.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Done according to rule.
E.
वि before धा to have, क्त्रि aff., and मप् augment.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Abandoned, left, deserted, deprived of.
E.
वि before हा to abandon, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sported, played.
2 Expanded.
n. (-तं)
One of the feminine acts or properties indicating love, hesitation, reluctance (in a female) to avow her feelings to her lover.
E.
वि before हृ to take, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Opening, expansion.
2 Sport, pastime.
E.
वि apart, हृ to convey, aff. क्तिच्.

ind.
1 Having sported.
2 Having or being spread.
E.
वि before हृ to take, ल्यप aff.

m. (-ठः)
Hurting, injury.
E.
वि before हेठ to annoy, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
An injurer, a reviler, one who inflicts pain or injury on another.
E.
वि, हेठ to annoy, aff. वुन्.

n. (-नं)
1 Injury, hurting, wounding, killing.
2 Rubbing, grinding.
3 Afflicting, distressing.
4 Pain, sorrow, affliction.
E.
वि before हेठ to annoy or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Agitated, alarmed, overcome with fear or agitation, beside one's self, unable to restrain one's self.
2 Distressed, afflicted.
3 Fused, liquid.
E.
वि before ह्वल to shake, aff. अच.

f. (-ता)
Agitation, anxiety.
E.
विह्वल, and तल् aff. also with त्व, विह्वलत्वं.
